notes:
Until now, two people with the same name got the same username, which was a gap. District Settings (and the setup wizard) now let you number duplicates the way you do.

New settings:

Duplicate student usernames / Duplicate staff usernames:
Leave as is
Add 1, 2, 3 gives j.smith, j.smith1, j.smith2
Add 2, 3, 4 gives j.smith, j.smith2, j.smith3
Who already has the name:
Everyone in SAM, including people who left (the default): numbers never change.
Only current staff/students: a name can shift down when someone leaves.
Staff email comes from: you can now use the email stored for the employee in SAM instead of building it from the pattern.

How it decides who gets which number: the oldest SAM record keeps the plain name. The 2nd person with that name gets 1 (or 2), the 3rd gets the next number, and so on. A new hire never changes anyone else’s username. The number goes on the email too, so the 2nd j.smith is j.smith1@hancockschools.net. Patterns that include the full ID can’t repeat, so they never get a number.

One thing to check before you rely on it: the app can’t see your existing Google or AD accounts. If your j.smith1 was assigned in a different order than SAM’s records, the export won’t match. District Settings → Copy staff check query gives you a query to run in SAM. It lists everyone who shares a name and the numbered username each one would get, so you can compare with your real accounts. If they don’t match and you keep real emails in SAM, set Staff email comes from to SAM.

Numbering makes staff and student export queries a little slower, because each row is compared against others with the same name.
